title: Very disappointed!!!
text: Very disappointed!!!. This Bestier Kitchen Bakers Rack was no good.  The fake wood split into when it fell from the box.  I immediately returned it back to the company.  The only reason I gave it a star was so that I could post my comment.  Don't waste your money.  Rack is cheaply made as well.

【Adjustable Leg Pads and Lockable Wheels】 This microwave oven stand cart comes with both adjustable feet leg and movable wheel, you can choose which style you like to assemble it.

【Premium P2 Board】 Kitchen storage rack organizer is made of healthy P2 board, which is waterproof, sturdy and durable. Nice looking and smooth surface also easy for cleaning. Plus the solid metal frame, this kitchen storage cart is strong enough to hold your kitchen tools.
